questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Abnegation
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**renouncement"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the given words:
 
 
• **Abnegation:** the act of renouncing or rejecting something, especially something that is valued, desired or important.

 
 
• Eg. He **abnegated** the throne in favour of his son.
 
 
 
• **Renouncement:** the act of giving up or rejecting something, is the correct answer. 
 
 
• Eg. He **renounced** all worldly pleasures took to a life of asceticism.
 
 
 
• **Sacrifice**: an act of giving up something valued for the sake of something else regarded as more important or worthy.
 
 
• Eg. He **sacrificed** his dignity to gain favour with them.
 
 
 
• **Abduction**: the action of taking someone away by force or deception.
 
 
• Eg. Alien **abduction** stories are pretty common in the United States.
 
 
 
• **Materialism**: a tendency to consider material possessions and physical comfort as more important than spiritual values.
 
 
• Eg. All **materialistic** pleasures need to be relinquished in order to live a spiritual life.
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above meanings and examples, we can conclude that "**abnegation"** is the **synonym** of "**renouncement"**.

Thus, ***option 1*** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• Abnegation: {किसी चीज को त्यागने या अस्वीकार करने का कार्य, विशेष रूप से कुछ ऐसा जो मूल्यवान, वांछित या महत्वपूर्ण हो।}
 
• Renouncement: {किसी चीज को छोड़ देना या अस्वीकार करना, सही उत्तर है।}
 
• Sacrifice: {अधिक महत्वपूर्ण या योग्य मानी जाने वाली किसी चीज़ के लिए मूल्यवान वस्तु का त्याग करने की क्रिया।}
 
• Abduction: {किसी को बलपूर्वक या धोखे से दूर ले जाने की क्रिया।}
 
• Materialism: {भौतिक संपत्ति और भौतिक आराम को आध्यात्मिक मूल्यों से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण मानने की प्रवृत्ति।}

questions.question: Identify the inference drawn from the passage

options.text: Dolphins are of the same size
Dolphins are found in oceans, rivers and streams.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Dolphins are found in oceans, rivers and streams.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• There are few dolphin species - This is incorrect. The passage specifies that there are 36 known dolphin species, which means they do not constitute just a few species.
 
• Dolphins like to smile - This is incorrect. The passage notes that dolphins have a "permanent 'smile'", but this description refers to the physical characteristic of their curved mouths, not to an emotional state.
 
• Dolphins are of the same size - This is incorrect. The passage clearly states that dolphin sizes range from the orca, which can reach over 30 feet long, to the Maui dolphin, which is just 5 feet long. This variation demonstrates that dolphins are not all the same size.
